en: The Section on the Present and the Future (Paccuppannānāgatavāra)
He who fully understands the eye-base will also fully understand the ear-base? No.
Or rather, he who will fully understand the ear-base fully understands the eye-base? No.
He who does not fully understand the eye-base will also not fully understand the ear-base? No.
Those who will attain the path do not fully understand the eye-base, yet they will not fail to fully understand the ear-base.
Those who are arahants and those ordinary persons who will not attain the path do not fully understand the eye-base and will not fully understand the ear-base.
Or again, is it the case that whoever will not fully understand the ear-base will also not fully understand the eye-base?
One who possesses the supreme path (aggamaggasamaṅgī) will not fully understand the ear-base, but he does not fail to fully understand the eye-base.
An Arhat and those worldlings (puthujjana) who will not attain the path will neither fully understand the ear-base nor [the eye-base].
And they do not fully understand the eye-base.
